## What's new in 3.17.4: a cleaner start

- **Straight into the game.** The studio splash is gone: the game opens on the title screen (or
  the 4:04 opening, the first time you play).
- **A shorter title menu.** Continue, New Run, Daily Run, Journal and Options. What's new now
  lives in the Journal (it still opens by itself after an update), and the bottom of the screen
  shows just your next goal and the version.
- **No credits screen.** The typeface licences are still in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt beside the game.
- **New character, not new reader.** The pop-up for unlocking a character says what it means.
